7. Submitted the best support found: **[36+, 18+, 9+]** at in-sample Sharpe 0.9955.

I was unable to log the formal `predict` call before the session closed (the tool refused post-submission), but my belief was: **mean out-of-sample Sharpe ≈ 0.65, sd ≈ 0.4**, reflecting a meaningful haircut from the in-sample figure for typical overfitting decay despite the convergent/robust nature of the search, balanced against genuine confidence from multiple independent restarts failing to beat this combination.
